Agenda and Minutes

The ‘Agenda’ is the name of the document containing everything that will be discussed at the Council Meeting. 

The ‘Minutes’ are the official record of business conducted at Council meetings.  The unconfirmed minutes are available within 10 business days after the meeting was held and are confirmed at the following Council meeting. 

The Agenda and Minutes for all meetings are available on this site.
